_comment: Loaded only when DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=local (`func start`, and the docker-compose stack).
The quota tier table below is the local counterpart of what infra emits on a deployed host as
infra/main.bicep `quotaTiers` parameter that creates the APIM products (#201). It is NOT in
appsettings.json on purpose: a shipped copy plus the deployed environment variables would be two
sources for one table, and the one the deployment did not set would silently win.
Keep these identical to the Api's appsettings.local.json — FunctionsAppSettingsTests pins that.
